{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for non-numeric values in the 'revenue' column
non_numeric_mask = df['revenue'].str.contains(r'[^0-9.]', na=False)
non_numeric_count = non_numeric_mask.sum()

# Display the non-numeric values
non_numeric_values = df.loc[non_numeric_mask, 'revenue'].unique()

print(f"Non-numeric revenue entries: {non_numeric_count}")
print(f"Unique non-numeric values: {non_numeric_values}")"}
